Incident history (23)

📅 2024-03-18 – 2024-04-01 Invasion / Ground Assault INC-115
Hospital completely destroyed — in ruins, permanently non-functional All buildings and departments destroyed ~1,050 surrounding houses burned or damaged Gaza lost its only teaching hospital — 750 beds, 26 operating theatres, serving 250,000 people annually WHO called it "ripping the heart out of the health system in Gaza" Only 10 hospitals partially functional across all of Gaza after this

On 18 March 2024, Israeli forces entered Al-Shifa Hospital in Gaza City, the largest hospital in Gaza. Israeli forces said Hamas had regrouped there. The operation lasted 14 days and ended on 1 April 2024 when Israeli forces withdrew.During the operation, heavy fighting took place inside and around the hospital. Medical staff and patients were locked in one building with no food, clean water, or working toilet. Civil defense teams were blocked from entering to help the wounded.When Israeli forces left on 1 April, the hospital was completely destroyed and can no longer function as a hospital.

21 killed

📅 2023-12-17 – 2023-12-18 Strikes INC-114
Strikes on 17 & 18th on entrance gate and surgery department.

On 17 December, at least 31 people were reportedly killed in Al Shifa Hospital in Gaza city. Three people were reportedly shot and injured inside the hospital compound, and another three persons were shot and injured when they were trying to fetch water near the hospital gate. On 18 December, in the early morning, Al Shifa Hospital was struck again, including the entrance gate and the Surgery Building. Reportedly, the strikes killed five people, including children. At about 10:30, the hospital was struck again where IDPs were sheltering, reportedly killing 26 Palestinians and injuring others.

57 killed

📅 2023-11-15 – 2023-11-21 Invasion / Ground Assault INC-109
the hospital is no longer operational, not admitting new patients. Israeli operations within the hospital.

Israeli operations at Shifa Hospital continued on 20 November for the fifth consecutive day. Nineteen health workers and 259 patients remain in Shifa, according to MoH in Gaza, as of 19 November, facing critical shortages of power, water, and medical supplies. This includes two people in intensive care, 22 dialysis patients, 32 stretcher patients, and 27 patients with spinal injuries, who will be prioritized for the next evacuation. The hospital is no longer operational and is not admitting new patients.

📅 2023-11-11 – 2023-11-16 Siege INC-102
40 patients died, 3 premature babies died.

The MoH in Gaza stated that, between 11 November and 16 November, 40 patients, including 3 premature babies, have died in Shifa Hospital due to lack of electricity. On 16 November, a patient who suffered from kidney failure died because dialysis machines at Shifa had stopped working.

40 killed

📅 2023-11-11 siege , encirclement INC-103
a patient in ICU and two incubated babies died due to absence of electricity.

On 11 November, the Director of Shifa hospital was cited in the media as stating that there was no more food, water or electricity. A patient in the Intesive Care Unit and two incubated babies reportedly died as their life support machines shut down due to absence of electricity. It is estimated that 15,000 people are still sheltering within Shifa Hospital.

Sources: 🔗 ochaopt
View full incident →
📅 2023-11-11 – 2023-11-24 Invasion / Ground Assault INC-113
Hospital declared fully non-operational by around 18 November. 179 bodies buried in a mass grave inside the compound (15 Nov). 31 premature babies evacuated to Rafah (19 Nov), 5 had already died. 25 health workers and 259 patients still trapped inside as of 20–21 Nov. Hospital not destroyed totally, still partially standing, but non-functional.

Israeli forces first cut off fuel and power to Al-Shifa on 11 November, causing the deaths of patients including premature babies whose life support stopped working. Snipers were reported around the hospital, shooting at people trying to flee. On 15 November, troops and tanks formally entered and raided the compound, searching sections and interrogating people. The operation continued for at least 8 consecutive days. By 18 November, the hospital was fully non-operational. A mass grave was dug inside the compound for 179 bodies that could not be removed. Premature babies were eventually evacuated on 19 November, though 5 had already died. The hospital director and paramedics were arrested.

45 killed3 health workers killed
